Quick question: When did you last find out a product was out of stock AFTER a customer tried to buy it?

That moment is the worst, isn't it? You either have to apologize, offer a substitute, or watch someone walk out (or click away) frustrated — and they might not come back.

For a lot of small business owners, inventory management is this constant background stress. You're checking counts manually, making your best guess on when to reorder, and occasionally getting blindsided when something runs out at exactly the wrong time.

Inventory alerts take that guesswork completely off your plate. When a product drops below a level YOU set, you get a notification — before it's a problem. Not after. You stay ahead of the gap instead of scrambling to close it.

No more surprise stockouts. No more missed sales. No more apologizing to a customer who really wanted that thing.
